cases.situation: Need my ex Mark to split our daughter Ava's braces. Total $4,800, $1,200 deposit due Nov 1, rest monthly. He usually argues about money.
cases.reply: Hi Mark, Dr Patel has recommended braces for Ava. The total is $4,800: a $1,200 deposit due 1 November, then $200 a month for 18 months. Quote attached. As per our agreement on medical costs, could you send your half of the deposit, $600, by 30 October? Please let me know by Friday. Thanks.
cases.note: Every number is in writing with the quote attached, which leaves little to argue about.

cases.situation: My ex sent a long angry text about me 'turning the kids against her', and at the very end asked if I'm still dropping them off Sunday at 5.
cases.reply: Yes, I'll drop Noah and Ella at yours on Sunday at 5 as planned.
cases.note: Answer the logistics, ignore the rest. If the accusations continue, keep a record and raise it through mediation, not by text.

cases.situation: 离婚两年，孩子朵朵平时跟前妻住，我隔周周末接她。10月17、18日那个周末我要出差，想和前妻换到24、25日。
cases.reply: 你好，10月17、18日那个周末我要出差，想和你换一下：我改接24、25日，17、18日朵朵留在你那边。可以的话周三前回我一下，谢谢。
cases.note: 一条消息只谈一件事，给出具体日期和回复期限，不提以往。

cases.situation: My ex Jenna and I keep ending up in 40-message text fights that start with a pickup time and end with stuff from 2019. I want to propose moving all scheduling to a co-parenting app. The kids are Liam (9) and Rosie (6).
cases.reply: Hi Jenna, to keep things simpler for both of us, could we move all scheduling and costs for Liam and Rosie to OurFamilyWizard from Monday 5 October? Then we both see the same calendar and receipts in one place, and texts can stay for anything urgent on the day. I've set up an account and can send you an invite tonight. Can you let me know by Friday if that works?
cases.note: Frame the app as simpler for both, with no mention of the fights; one line about 2019 would start the next one.

cases.situation: I've been seeing Dan for about a year and want him to meet our son Leo (7) at something low-key. My ex Chris and I get on okay-ish. I want him to hear it from me first.
cases.reply: Hi Chris, I wanted you to hear this from me first. I've been seeing someone, Dan, for about a year, and I'm planning for him to meet Leo briefly at the park on Saturday 17 October, about an hour, nothing framed as a big deal. If you have any concerns, can you let me know by Sunday 11 October so we can talk before then? Thanks.
cases.note: Informing, not asking permission: give the date and a window to raise concerns, and keep it free of relationship detail.
